name: research-pipeline
description: Research-grounded pipeline plugin — adds the research family, architecture phase, blocking briefs, knowledge index, doc-review, and quality-checkpoint to projects using the agile-workflow substrate. Companion to nklisch/skills agile-workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Research-grounded planning on top of the agile-workflow substrate
interface.longDescription: Research-grounded pipeline that feeds the agile-workflow substrate: the research family (research / deep-research / research-program), architecture, blocking briefs, knowledge index, doc-review, and a release-gate-orchestrating quality-checkpoint. Produces research-grounded epic items and runs cascading consistency checks.
defaultPrompt: Use research-pipeline to load the knowledge index and recommend the next research or design step.
